purpose: Unresolved, version-sensitive, or weakly evidenced profile questions exposed by the exhaustive indexed-mail analysis. These are prompts for future evidence collection, not facts to guess.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: What exact Berea College major should Agent OS use?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: Bachelor's degree completion is treated as confirmed; prior resume/profile material conflicts on the exact major.
safe_resolution_paths: diploma/transcript or official school record if the user chooses to provide it

unresolved_profile_questions.question: What became of the master's in Audio Engineering mentioned in a May 2025 user-authored email?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: A May 2025 account-authored message mentioned a master's in Audio Engineering, but shared-account contamination is now known and no independent corroboration establishes this as the user's program.
unresolved_profile_questions.rule: Do not describe this as the user's credential or enrollment unless actor attribution or newer direct evidence confirms it.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: What is the current co-residence/housing state with Olivia?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: Olivia is treated as the current girlfriend and shared-household planning partner; historical housing evidence and a September 2026 rental application do not yet establish the current long-term residence state.
unresolved_profile_questions.rule: Use direct/current housing evidence; do not infer an address or co-residence state from old leases or purchases.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: What was the outcome of the September 2026 rental application?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: The indexed mail shows an application under review but not a confidently resolved long-term state.
unresolved_profile_questions.rule: Keep housing-cost and address assumptions variable until a later outcome is observed or stated.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: Is the iPhone 11 signal the user's active current phone or only an accessory/household purchase?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: Personally addressed case/screen-protector orders support but do not prove active device ownership.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: Is the Nintendo Switch 2 personally owned by the user or a household device?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: Repeated accessory purchases support a household device but not exclusive ownership.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: Should ongoing job alerts after the RTEC start be interpreted as an active search?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: Automated alerts continue after April 2026 but direct application/interview evidence does not establish a new active search period.
unresolved_profile_questions.rule: Require direct application, recruiter, interview, or user-stated evidence before marking a renewed active search.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: What additional profile/project facts are contained in the archived attachment bodies?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: 231 of 232 original attachment records were metadata-only in the indexed corpus. As of 2026-09-25, Agent OS has a read-only retrospective attachment recovery and local extraction pipeline, but the binaries still must be re-fetched/analyzed on the machine with the configured iCloud account.
unresolved_profile_questions.rule: Never infer contents from filenames. After local recovery, retain raw binaries/extracted text locally and promote only sanitized, provenance-backed conclusions.

unresolved_profile_questions.question: Which recurring social/work identities across imported sources refer to the same real people?
unresolved_profile_questions.current_evidence: Several recurring social/work identity signals appear across imported sources without enough evidence for safe merges: a named social-contact candidate, an unidentified recurring friend, a workplace same-name collision with a durable personal contact, a cross-context work contact, and a historical/current work first-name collision.
unresolved_profile_questions.rule: Do not merge by name equality or interaction frequency. Keep unresolved third-party identities and raw identifiers local; require contextual/stable-identifier evidence or user confirmation.

contradictions_and_version_rules.rule: Use the newest direct user statement; retain old labels only as dated historical evidence.
Current accepted/started role outranks old applications and automated job alerts.
Historical leases and applications are timeline evidence; do not infer a current address from old records.
Direct purchase/account events are time-bounded; accessories and marketing do not establish current ownership.
Self-reported enrollment is not the same as completion; do not promote a degree without corroboration.

profile_questions_worth_asking_only_when: Exact Berea degree/major, if a career/resume/education task needs it.
Current status of the 2025 Audio Engineering master's, if education or audio work becomes relevant.
Current housing outcome, if budgeting, moving, utilities, or location-specific planning needs it.
Current device ownership, only when troubleshooting or purchasing advice depends on the exact device.
profile_questions_not_worth_interrupting: Names/contact details of private third parties who are not relevant to a current task.
Whether every paid-study invitation was completed.
Whether every Steam wishlist title was purchased or played.
Whether every household purchase represents the user's own preference.
attachment_recovery_plan: Recover attachment binaries from the original mail archive/provider or source extraction pipeline.
Extract text locally with format-appropriate parsers and OCR only when needed.
Link extracted evidence back to message_id/attachment_id.
Run the same confidence, sensitivity, version, and promotion filters used for message text.
Only promote durable sanitized findings into Git.
